title: XOR as multiplication under the $\pm 1$ embedding
statement:
Let $\mathrm{BoolToPM1} : \mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$ be the map sending $\mathtt{false}$ to $1$ and $\mathtt{true}$ to $-1$. Then for all Booleans $a$ and $b$,
\[
  \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(a \oplus b) = \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(a)\cdot\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(b),
\]
so the exclusive-or $a \oplus b$ is carried to the ordinary product in $\{-1,1\}\subset\bbr$.
